title: Visible handwashing and exit flow

reference.title: Visible handwashing and exit flow
reference.scope: Reference for the visible actions in the bundled video, not a complete hygiene procedure. Hidden towel release and actual door opening are not required.

steps.label: Lower towel into bin
steps.criterion: The hand moves paper below the rim of a lined bin. Visible release is not required.

steps.label: Hold door handle through a towel
steps.criterion: The hand grips a visible door lever through paper. Actual door opening is not required.

steps.label: Dry hands with the towel
steps.criterion: Paper contacts the hands as they rub or fold it between them; continued pulling from the slot is different.

steps.label: Pull a paper towel
steps.criterion: A sheet is visibly pulled out of a wall dispenser slot. Holding paper nearby is not enough.

steps.label: Rinse under running water
steps.criterion: A visible flowing water stream contacts the hands. Foam alone is not rinsing.

steps.label: Rub hands with lather
steps.criterion: Hands rub with visible foam. Running water is not required.

steps.label: Dispense soap
steps.criterion: White soap appears on a palm beneath a dispenser; mechanism actuation may be occluded.

steps.reason: The hand and white paper enter the lined bin opening at 22.5 s; at 22.903 s paper extends below the bag-lined rim with the hand above it.
steps.uncertainty: The exact release of the paper is not visible and is not required by this reference.
steps.label: Lower towel into bin

steps.reason: The 21 s image mainly shows the wall and bin; at 21.75 s a blurred hand holds white paper near the door, but a gripped lever is not clearly visible. The lever is visible without a hand at 22.903 s. These sheets do not establish paper-mediated handle contact.
steps.uncertainty: A clearer sample between the scene cut and the bin action is needed. Do not infer grip from the reference label or earlier reviews.
steps.label: Hold door handle through a towel

steps.reason: The white paper is between both hands, then folded or rubbed against the palms and fingers beside the dispenser.
steps.uncertainty: Dryness is not measurable from these images; the visible towel-contact action matches the reference.
steps.label: Dry hands with the towel

steps.reason: At 14.25 s the hand pulls a white sheet down from the wall dispenser slot; at 15 s the separated sheet is held beside the slot.
steps.uncertainty: The exact sheet separation occurs between samples.
steps.label: Pull a paper towel

steps.reason: At 12 and 12.75 s the visible white water stream from the faucet contacts the hands beneath it.
steps.uncertainty: The preceding crossfade obscures the exact transition into rinsing.
steps.label: Rinse under running water

steps.reason: Foamy hands rub palm surfaces, fingers, and the back of the hand across the sink views. No running stream is visible in these cited frames.
steps.uncertainty: Discrete frames do not show every intervening movement.
steps.label: Rub hands with lather

steps.reason: At 0 s a palm is held under the dispenser; at 0.75 s the palm has white soap as it moves away.
steps.uncertainty: The dispenser actuation is hidden by the other hand.
steps.label: Dispense soap

time_note: Cited sample order, not continuous execution or exact action boundaries.
reviewer: Codex vision session via file MCP sampling adapter
method: MCP sampling: host vision review of supplied reference and timestamped source-frame contact sheets
scope_note: Visible sample evidence only. Not proof of uninterrupted execution, hidden door opening or towel release.
control_kind: Same recorded observations compared to reversed reference; deterministic order control, no new vision inference.
